intro: Financial services, government, healthcare, and technology sectors faced significant exposure from five critical and high-severity vulnerabilities between April 12 and May 1, 2026. The six articles in this archive cover CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893, with a severity mix of three medium, two high, and one critical issue. These vulnerabilities impacted organisations globally, with particular focus on the United Kingdom.
